invariants: Do not delete the original 13 customs or 71 attestations; retain IDs, sources, and negative knowledge.
Do not put regional or universal customs on a fabricated point map.
The target module owns presentation/links, not a cloned practice data corpus.
Local Calendar observances are not universal 1962 Roman feasts.
Historical local practices are not prescribed rubrics.
migration_order: Prepare contextual views and source links in Formation, PRAY, Calendar and place profiles.
Verify each of 13 custom IDs and 71 source attestations is accessible in at least one appropriate user route, including French presentation.
Hide the standalone Customs Atlas link and map lens only after owner-route tests pass.
Retain original source corpus in version control; never delete the evidence when navigation is removed.
